whatWeDo.label: WHAT WE DO
whatWeDo.headline:
Everything Japan needs,

in one stop.
whatWeDo.lead: PLAYWAN Gaming supports overseas game companies in Japan across three connected domains.

ip.title: IP COLLABORATION
ip.subtitle: Collaboration with Japanese IP
ip.body: We use our network of Japanese publishers, games, anime, and character holders. From selection to negotiation, contracts, and supervision, we coordinate the right IP for the title, audience, budget, and territory.

creative.title: CREATIVE PRODUCTION
creative.subtitle: From game assets to advertising, produced as one.
creative.body: A license alone does not complete a collaboration. PLAYWAN produces the creative needed to implement IP in the game, then extends that same quality into Japan-facing promotion assets.

marketing.title: JAPAN MARKETING
marketing.subtitle: Create conversation in Japan.
marketing.body: Asian game companies are strong in online marketing. Japan’s offline market still needs local media selection, contracts, review, production, and installation. PLAYWAN becomes the Japan desk and coordinates agencies, media owners, event teams, and PR partners.

privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: PlayWan Gaming Inc. (“we”) handles personal information obtained through inquiries and other business activities as follows.
privacy.s1b: Through our contact form we may collect company name, name, email address, country or region, inquiry details, and optional URL, budget, and timing.
privacy.s2b: We use this information to respond to inquiries, review requests, communicate as needed, improve our services, and comply with law.
privacy.s3b: We do not provide personal information to third parties without consent except as required by law. Form submissions may be processed by Formspree.
privacy.s4b: We take appropriate measures to prevent leakage, loss, or damage of personal information.
privacy.s5b: To request disclosure, correction, or suspension of use, contact us via the inquiry form.
privacy.s6b: We may update this policy. The revised version takes effect when posted on this page.
